verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents data retention (prompts and responses stored on xAI's servers, grok-docs-21) and vague 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' for team workspaces (grok-docs-13), but nowhere mentions an opt-out toggle, training-data exclusion setting, or policy statement about excluding user conversations from model training. This axis clearly applies to a consumer/enterprise AI chat product, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
